title: 荒园复苏

generationRuns.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. 生成一张1024x1536竖幅不透明塔罗闪卡完整绘画母版。参考图仅用于人物身份和精致古典幻想手绘画风，新主题须独立重构场景构图。荒园复苏：一位参考图同身份的棕色长发成年女子，穿苔绿色与象牙白古典长裙、细星冠，人物下中跪在完整园中石岸，两手各持一壶。左壶连续水流注入水池，右壶另一个独立连续水流注入石溪，两落点新芽生长。废弃花园、破旧拱墙向后退去，一个主八芒星居高。土金、苔绿、蓝，叶脉星金窄框。完整整片石岸、浅池与接水地面，不仅膝下小石片。 保持自然肤色，双手双臂准确；必须只有一人、双壶双水流双落点，一个主八芒星，不可单流分叉充当双流。高细节绘画，清晰自然接触阴影，完整承接地面延伸到底边，窄边框不遮挡主体，满幅不透明画面。无文字、无字母数字、无标志水印，无拼图，无多余人物或手臂。

Edit the supplied image. Output exactly one 1024x1536 image. Keep the original canvas coordinates and size of RETAINED objects only. Objects explicitly removed must be deleted completely; do not preserve their number. No redesign, no recentering, no frame except when frame is specifically requested. BACKGROUND PLATE ONLY. Delete ALL people, ALL animals, ALL main foreground props, ALL foreground support platforms/floors and their contact shadows, ALL floating foreground decoration, and the entire outer border/corner ornaments. NO people or animals may remain, including silhouettes and reflections. Reconstruct the distant environment naturally behind deleted objects. Keep only the distant landscape/architecture and original atmosphere. Do not add a second copy of the support ground. Opaque RGB image. Specific removed connected group: 人物、双壶、两条连续水流与接水地面整体；仅离散水滴独立；本主题支撑归属：整片园中石岸及浅池，不只抠膝下石片. Environment ownership details: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。. Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture. Image 1 is the edit target.
